// _comment: Maps each maintained engine-docs version to its mike alias, dropdown title, and whether it is the site default (the version `/` redirects to). Each version is published from its own long-lived branch `release/<version>`; pushing to that branch republishes only that version's slot on gh-pages. To add a version: create release/<version>, add an entry here. To promote preview -> stable on release: flip `default` and the alias/title here, then push the branch.
